reason: README documents a `nougat` CLI that runs the small 0.1.0-small model (~1GB download from GitHub releases, no auth) on a PDF, feasible on CPU for one page.
demo: README 'Get prediction for a PDF' > CLI: nougat path/to/file.pdf -o output_directory
goal: Install nougat-ocr from /work/nougat as the README describes so the `nougat` command works on CPU, and make /work/env.sh activate that environment. Then `nougat some.pdf -o outdir --no-skipping -p 1` must download the default 0.1.0-small checkpoint and write a non-empty .mmd file with the recognized text of a simple one-page PDF.
check: Runs the nougat CLI on a generated one-page text PDF and checks that a non-empty .mmd output file is produced containing recognizable words from the page.

revision.by: second review (outside the maintained set; independent log check of maintained passes)
issues: Leaked install hint: the goal says '(resolve any dependency version conflicts, e.g. transformers/albumentations/pypdfium2 pins)'. The README says only `pip install nougat-ocr` / from repository; nothing about pin conflicts. The pypdfium2 hint is exactly the fix the run needed (agent pinned pypdfium2==4.30.0 because 5.x removed `render`), so the pass was helped by the goal.
Oracle itself is sound: the CLI command and flags (--no-skipping, -p) are from the README, and the run produced the page text verbatim. Re-run with the neutral goal below.
evidence: README.md 'Install' — `pip install nougat-ocr` / `pip install git+https://github.com/facebookresearch/nougat`; no mention of version conflicts or pins
setup.py:46-60 — pypdfium2 is unpinned, so the current 5.x is installed by a plain README install
data/runs/facebookresearch-nougat/result.json agent.final — 'pypdfium2==4.30.0 (5.x removed render, which broke the plain README install)'
README.md CLI usage — documents --no-skipping and --pages/-p; default model tag 0.1.0-small
